comparator.name: Pedagogische Wetenschappen
comparator.sourceNotes: Reconstructed from VU Amsterdam's current official sources for the Fall-2026 cohort: the Bachelor Pedagogische Wetenschappen programme content page, its toekomst/career page, and the Bachelor's programme Pedagogische Wetenschappen 2026-2027 Onderwijs- en Examenregeling (OER/TER), the formally adopted regulation governing the programme (Article 7.1: RIO number 56607). Article 10.2 confirms the opleiding offers two trajecten: 'Pedagogische Wetenschappen' (180 EC over three years) and 'Universitaire Pabo (PA2)' (240 EC over four years, combining the VU curriculum with a participating pabo and requiring separate dual enrolment at that pabo under Article 8.1.4). The normalized target is the generic 'B Pedagogische wetenschappen' bachelor and does not name the Universitaire Pabo dual-enrolment variant; the Pedagogische Wetenschappen traject shares the opleiding's own name, requires no additional external enrolment, and matches the registry's normalized 180-EC study load, so it is the programme's broad academic identity, while Universitaire Pabo is a specialised joint track for a narrower population. This reconstruction therefore follows the Pedagogische Wetenschappen traject under the route-selection rule's broad-academic-identity step, fixed before any UCR course was considered. Article 11.3 lists the traject's 24 compulsory onderwijseenheden, including two administrative 0-EC units (Mentoraat and Proefpersoonschap, a first-year participant-pool requirement that Article 9.1.2 makes a formal condition for registering the result of Observatievaardigheden); because these two units carry no credit weight they are not separately listed as curriculum components here, but the remaining 22 compulsory units total 138 EC. Article 11.4a requires students to choose one of three 12-EC preminoren in year 2 (Onderwijsleerprocessen in de klas; Praktijken van Pedagogische Hulpverlening Jeugdhulp; Praktijken van Pedagogische Hulpverlening Zorgintensieve Kinderen); because the target is generic and target-specific programme-interest evidence supports the 'pedagogical assistance and counselling' and 'learning processes and educational improvement' directions equally (both explicit Stable study direction rows, 5076 and 5077), and no preminor is formally more general than the others, the official listed order in Article 11.4a was used as the neutral tie-break, selecting the first-listed preminor, 'Onderwijsleerprocessen in de klas' (Onderwijsleerprocessen in de klas: theoretische benaderingen, P_BMONLKT, 6 EC, and Onderwijsleerprocessen in de klas: Onderzoek in de praktijk, P_BPMONKO, 6 EC). Article 12.1 requires a genuine vrije keuzeruimte of at least 30 EC in the first semester of year 3 (a programmed minor, or a free choice of units including at least 12 EC at level 300); this is preserved as open space rather than instantiated with invented content. Article 11.3's B-these Pedagogische Wetenschappen (12 EC) is the bachelor thesis; Article 9.1 permits enrolment only after all year-1 units are completed. 138 (remaining compulsory units) + 12 (preminor) + 30 (open elective) = 180 EC. No further official source needed to be consulted: the programme content page, career page and OER/TER together establish a complete, internally consistent, entirely accounted-for 180-EC pathway with explicit EC weights and compulsory/elective status for every component, and an explicit, UCR-independent route-selection judgment (traject and preminor) fixed before any UCR course was considered.

routeSelection.basis: OER Article 10.2 names two trajecten: Pedagogische Wetenschappen (180 EC, three years) and Universitaire Pabo/PA2 (240 EC, four years, requiring concurrent dual enrolment at a participating pabo under Article 8.1.4). The normalized target is the generic 'B Pedagogische wetenschappen' bachelor and does not name the Universitaire Pabo dual-enrolment variant. The Pedagogische Wetenschappen traject shares the opleiding's own name, matches the registry's normalized 180-EC, three-year study load, and requires no additional external enrolment, so it represents the programme's broad academic identity, while Universitaire Pabo is a specialised joint track serving a narrower population already enrolled at a pabo. This selection was fixed before any UCR course was considered and does not depend on UCR fit.

selection.assessment: The closest match directly owns sixteen generator-eligible rows: how children develop and flourish within family, school and society and what disrupts that development (5067, 5068, 5069, 5070, 5072); the Gezin, Opvoeding en Hulpverlening and Samenleving, Opvoeding en Onderwijs pillars themselves (5073, 5075); diversity and dilemmas including bullying, pedagogical assistance and counselling (5071, 5076, 5080); attachment and the effects of family disruption such as high-conflict divorce (5078, 5082); observation, measurement and diagnostic assessment (5086, 5087); interviewing and counselling conversation skills (5088); and statistics and pedagogical research methodology (5089). The remaining four generator-eligible rows -- pupils, education and guidance (5074); learning processes and educational improvement (5077); learning and behavioural difficulties (5079); and high ability and diverse learning needs (5081) -- were independently assessed as one candidate direction, 'Learning, Cognition & Educational Guidance', because together they describe the same substantive focus on how pupils learn and are guided in educational settings that VU itself organises as a distinct preminor (Onderwijsleerprocessen in de klas) alongside the closest match's own broader pillars. UCR's entire cognitive-science-of-learning catalogue relevant to this direction -- Perception & Action and Higher Order Functions, the only two courses in UCR's catalogue that address how the brain processes information, attention and reasoning relevant to learning -- is already fully used by the closest match as a complementary neuropsychological strand (paired with Neuropsychologie voor Pedagogen and with the closest match's own coverage of Leerling, Onderwijs en Begeleiding). A second alternative built around this direction as its own organising concept would therefore either reuse those same two courses together with the closest match's own shared foundational psychology, sociology, philosophy, communication and research-methods courses -- UCR's catalogue contains no further dedicated education, learning-science or classroom-pedagogy courses to substitute -- falling well short of the required 30-EC/four-course floor once that necessary overlap is considered, or import unrelated courses (such as UCR's general law curriculum, which VU's own programme does not include at all) merely to force numerical distinctness. Because the candidate's own evidence is already substantively covered by the closest match's exhausted use of UCR's small relevant catalogue, and no genuinely different 24-course curriculum follows from it given UCR's actual course offerings, it is rejected as not-substantively-distinct rather than manufactured through arbitrary course substitution, and production stops at one included alternative.

alternatives.label: Human Development in Family, School & Society
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum is built predominantly from UCR's developmental, social and clinical psychology cluster (8 of 24 courses: Social Psychology, Statistics & Experimental Methods, Abnormal Psychology, Medical & Health Psychology, Psychodiagnostics & Psychotherapies, Lifespan Developmental Psychology, Youth Resilience to Extremism and Advanced Research Seminar), its sociology cluster (4 of 24: Introduction to Sociology, Qualitative Research Methodology, Modern Sociology and New Issues in Contemporary Social Theory), its philosophy cluster (3 of 24: Introduction to Western Philosophy, Ethics and Philosophy of Mind), its cognitive-neuroscience cluster (2 of 24: Perception & Action and Higher Order Functions), its communication cluster (3 of 24: The Art of Rhetorical Communication, Rhetoric in Action and Persuasive Communication), its research-methods/biological-foundations courses (3 of 24: Research Methods & Statistics, Introduction to Brain & Behavior and Foundation of Life, Health & Biomedicine) and Personal & Professional Development. The label names human development first because that is the substantive thread running through every cluster, and names family, school and society because those are the three concrete settings -- corresponding to the programme's own Gezin/Opvoeding/Hulpverlening, Leerling/Onderwijs/Begeleiding and Samenleving/Opvoeding/Onderwijs pillars -- in which the completed curriculum studies that development. The label deliberately does not use 'pedagogy' or 'education' as a discipline name: UCR has no dedicated pedagogy, education or family-support-services department, so the completed curriculum approaches the target field through related disciplines (psychology, sociology, cognitive science, philosophy, communication) rather than reproducing a professional pedagogy curriculum, and it does not claim a supervised practicum, applied family-support-services training, or classroom-teaching placement comparable to VU's own Observatievaardigheden, Gespreksvaardigheden progression, Meten en Diagnostiek sequence or preminor.
alternatives.concept: The closest feasible UCR response to VU's Pedagogische Wetenschappen bachelor: reconstructing, through UCR's developmental and clinical psychology, sociology, cognitive science, philosophy and communication courses, the programme's three structural pillars -- family, upbringing and support (Gezin, Opvoeding en Hulpverlening); pupils, education and guidance (Leerling, Onderwijs en Begeleiding); and society, upbringing and education (Samenleving, Opvoeding en Onderwijs) -- together with its integrated methods, statistics, diagnostic-assessment and conversation-skills training. It honestly preserves that UCR offers no dedicated professional-pedagogy curriculum, applied family-support-services training, or supervised practicum comparable to VU's own Observatievaardigheden, Gespreksvaardigheden progression, Meten en Diagnostiek sequence or year-2 preminor.
progression: No UCR course in this alternative carries a formal prerequisite except the four courses that require HCBGATE102 (HCBPSYC212, HCBCOGN212, HCBPSYC311, HCBPSYC312, HCBPSYC314, HCBCOGN311 and HCBPSYC313); HCBGATE102 is scheduled in semester 1, before every course that depends on it. Personal & Professional Development is scheduled in semester 2, within Year 1. Introductory and gateway courses are concentrated in semesters 1-2 (Introduction to Brain & Behavior, Introduction to Sociology, Introduction to Western Philosophy and The Art of Rhetorical Communication in semester 1; Personal & Professional Development, Research Methods & Statistics, Social Psychology and Abnormal Psychology in semester 2), while level-3 advanced work is concentrated in semesters 3-6 (Medical & Health Psychology in semester 3; Psychodiagnostics & Psychotherapies and Lifespan Developmental Psychology in semester 4; New Issues in Contemporary Social Theory, Higher Order Functions, Persuasive Communication and Youth Resilience to Extremism in semester 5; Advanced Research Seminar in semester 6), so that foundational training precedes advanced work. Where an advisory continuation exists in the course evidence, it is honoured: Perception & Action (semester 4) precedes the more advanced Higher Order Functions (semester 5), both of which build on Introduction to Brain & Behavior (semester 1); Statistics & Experimental Methods (semester 3) and Qualitative Research Methodology (semester 6) both build on the introductory Research Methods & Statistics (semester 2); and Advanced Research Seminar, which explicitly builds on prior methods training, is scheduled last, in semester 6, immediately before the programme concludes. Every course is offered in its assigned semester under the fixed Fall 2026 cohort schedule.

blocks: Both are the field's foundational gateway course: Inleiding in de Pedagogiek is VU's own introduction to pedagogy; Introduction to Brain & Behavior is UCR's gateway course into the developmental, clinical and cognitive-science study that the closest match builds on it.

Both are the general introductory research-methodology and statistics course: Methodologie 1 is VU's own foundational methods unit; Research Methods & Statistics covers the logics and design of research, operationalisation, sampling and specific techniques.

Statistiek 1 is VU's dedicated first-year statistics unit. Research Methods & Statistics, which substantively covers introductory statistics content, is already matched to Methodologie 1 above under its own primary methodology framing and cannot be matched twice; no further UCR counterpart addresses introductory statistics specifically.

Both directly examine how individuals develop and change over the course of life: Ontwikkelingspsychologie voor Pedagogen is VU's own developmental-psychology unit; Lifespan Developmental Psychology explores how people become unique individuals across every stage of development.

Both introduce diagnostic assessment methods for psychological and pedagogical practice: Meten en Diagnostiek 1 is VU's own first diagnostics unit; Psychodiagnostics & Psychotherapies introduces the basic concepts, issues and methods of clinical psychodiagnostics.

Meten en Diagnostiek 2 is VU's second, more advanced diagnostics unit. Psychodiagnostics & Psychotherapies, UCR's only diagnostics-focused course, is already matched to Meten en Diagnostiek 1 above and cannot be matched twice; no further UCR counterpart offers a second level of diagnostic-assessment training.

Both deepen statistical training beyond the first-year introduction: Statistiek 2 is VU's second statistics unit; Statistics & Experimental Methods is explicitly positioned for students pursuing further research training beyond an introductory course.

Persoonlijkheidstheorie en -onderzoek is VU's dedicated personality-theory and personality-research unit. UCR's catalogue contains no course specifically on personality theory or personality assessment, so no counterpart is claimed.

Gezin, Opvoeding en Hulpverlening is VU's dedicated 9-EC unit on family, upbringing and youth/family support services. UCR's catalogue contains no course on applied family-support-services practice; Medical & Health Psychology and Youth Resilience to Extremism above offer complementary psychological perspectives on families and children under strain, but neither reproduces this applied support-services component, so no direct counterpart is claimed.

Both address how the wider social context, institutions and structures shape upbringing and education: Samenleving, Opvoeding en Onderwijs is VU's own societal pillar course; Introduction to Sociology provides the general toolkit for understanding how societies function at local and global scale.

Both deepen the programme's methodology beyond the first-year introduction with a qualitative, interview-based research orientation: Methodologie 2 extends VU's methods sequence; Qualitative Research Methodology trains qualitative research design and interview-based enquiry.

Grote Vragen over Opvoeding en Onderwijs is VU's own dedicated big-questions unit on upbringing and education. UCR's catalogue contains no equivalent unit posing this question explicitly as its organising frame, so no counterpart is claimed.

Both are the foundational first-year conversation/communication-skills unit: Gespreksvaardigheden 1 is VU's own unit; The Art of Rhetorical Communication trains the foundational communicative and persuasive skill on which later applied conversation work builds.

Both extend conversational skill into applied, practice-based work: Gespreksvaardigheden 2 (which OER Article 9.1.1 permits only after Gespreksvaardigheden 1) is VU's second-level unit; Rhetoric in Action applies rhetorical skill in a practice-based public-speaking and debating context.

Leerling, Onderwijs en Begeleiding is a broad, integrated pillar course on how pupils learn and how schools and educators can guide them that VU's curriculum does not subdivide into separately credited elements. Perception & Action addresses an important and identifiable part of that broad subject -- the neural mechanisms by which students perceive, attend to and act on information in educational settings -- even though it does not reproduce the pillar's full scope of classroom guidance, teacher-student relationships and pedagogical method, which UCR's catalogue does not otherwise offer.

Observatievaardigheden is VU's own dedicated observation-skills practicum, registrable only after Proefpersoonschap under OER Article 9.1.2. UCR's catalogue contains no equivalent supervised observation-practicum course, so no counterpart is claimed.

Both are the second-year neuropsychology-adjacent unit building on introductory brain-behaviour study: Neuropsychologie voor Pedagogen is VU's own unit; Higher Order Functions deepens neurophysiological and experimental cognitive-neuroscience knowledge built on Introduction to Brain & Behavior.

Both are the programme's applied, second-level philosophy unit treating the person being educated and guided: Filosofie voor Pedagogen is VU's own unit; Philosophy of Mind investigates the nature of consciousness, personal identity and the self.

Both are the programme's dedicated ethics unit: Pedagogische Ethiek is VU's own applied pedagogical-ethics capstone; Ethics explores the main theories of moral reasoning -- virtue ethics, deontology and consequentialism -- that ground applied ethical judgment.

Both are the programme's advanced, capstone-level research-methods unit preceding the thesis: Methodologie 3 Pedagogische Wetenschappen (registrable, per OER Article 9.1, only once all year-1 units are complete) is VU's own capstone methodology unit; Advanced Research Seminar trains systematic-review and meta-analysis methods used to synthesise research across studies.

Statistiek 3 Pedagogische Wetenschappen is VU's third, most advanced statistics unit. Advanced Research Seminar, UCR's most advanced quantitative-methods course, is already matched to Methodologie 3 above and cannot be matched twice; no further UCR counterpart offers a third level of statistical training.
Year-2 preminor & year-3 open elective space

The 12-EC year-2 preminor Onderwijsleerprocessen in de klas (OER Article 11.4a) is a supervised, practice-based unit combining theoretical approaches with practical research on classroom learning processes. UCR's catalogue contains no supervised classroom-practicum course, so no counterpart is claimed; Perception & Action and Higher Order Functions above already offer the closest available complementary cognitive-science perspective on how students learn.

The 30-EC year-3 vrije keuzeruimte (OER Article 12.1: a programmed minor, or a free choice of units including at least 12 EC at level 300) is genuine open profiling space with no fixed content specified by VU. It is preserved as open space and not matched to any UCR course.

B-these Pedagogische Wetenschappen is the 12-EC independent bachelor thesis (OER Article 9.1 permits enrolment only once all year-1 units are completed). No scheduled UCR course is a thesis; UCR's standardised Optional independent research element is shown in this row instead, consistent with researchComponentId.

notes.text: Pedagogische Wetenschappen combines a dedicated pedagogy curriculum -- family and youth support services, pupil guidance, developmental and personality psychology, measurement and diagnostics, conversation and observation skills, and a supervised practicum-based preminor -- with its own progression of methodology, statistics and a bachelor thesis. At UCR, students can approach how children and young people develop and how family, school and society can best support them through fields such as developmental and clinical psychology, sociology, cognitive neuroscience, philosophy and communication studies. These programmes therefore offer related perspectives on child and youth development rather than reproducing a full professional pedagogy curriculum.
